title: Winspace G3 Built with Mechanical Brakes and Shifting

takeaways.text: Size medium built with mechanical SRAM Rival 22 shifting and mechanical brakes: the steerer must be cut and the front brake line routed before final assembly because everything enters through the headset, and the fork has an entry port near the crown.
Fully internal mechanical routing with link-style housing worked but took a long time and eventually became aggravating; the oversized bar tops look bulky with cables run underneath.

disclosure: The description says the Winspace and other product links are affiliate links.
summary: Home build of a size M G3 with reused mechanical parts and Lún wheels, showing the order needed for fully internal brake and shift routing through the headset.
